job.title: Fund Accountant
job.description:
A privately owned real estate investment organization is seeking a Fund Accountant to join its finance team in Downtown Toronto. This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership of their work, values stability, and thrives in a collaborative environment. Supporting a dedicated real estate investment fund, you'll play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day accounting activity, and working closely with internal and external stakeholders in a hands-on finance function.

About the Role

Reporting to the Vice President of Finance, the Fund Accountant will be responsible for the day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities supporting a dedicated real estate investment fund. This is a highly focused role that combines transactional accounting, cash management, reconciliations, financial reporting, and stakeholder support. You'll have ownership of a defined area of the finance function, work closely with stakeholders to address accounting-related inquiries, and contribute to ongoing process improvements and future system enhancements.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain accurate financial records, general ledger entries, and supporting documentation for a dedicated real estate investment fund
  • Process payments, deposits, transfers, and other day-to-day accounting transactions in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain accurate records of bank and cash activity and support day-to-day cash management
  • Prepare account and bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies as required
  • Assist with monthly financial reporting, schedules, and analysis
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to respond to accounting inquiries and provide financial information as required
  • Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation for the assigned fund
  • Assist with accounting system improvements and potential future ERP or system migration initiatives
  • Contribute to a collaborative finance team while taking ownership of your assigned responsibilities

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of bookkeeping, fund accounting, property accounting, or general accounting experience
  • Experience within real estate, property management, investment management, or a similar asset-based industry is considered an asset
  • Hands-on experience with day-to-day accounting transactions, reconciliations, cash activity, and financial reporting
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with financial data
  • Experience with accounting or property management software; exposure to Yardi, Buildium, or similar platforms is an asset
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a focused workload independently
  • Professional communication skills and the ability to work comfortably with both internal and external stakeholders
  • A dependable, humble, and team-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership
  • A long-term mindset and interest in building a stable career within an organization where there is room to grow

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join a stable and collaborative organization that values consistency, accountability, and long-term employee success. You'll enjoy working in a relaxed, supportive environment with a high degree of autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful ownership of a dedicated area of the finance function. If you're looking for a hands-on accounting role where your work is valued, your contributions are visible, and you can build a long-term career without a highly corporate or heavily micromanaged environment, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

job.title: Project Accountant
job.description:
A project-driven organization in the natural resources and infrastructure sector is seeking a Project Accountant to join its finance team supporting a major development in Quebec. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with operations, contribute to the financial success of a large-scale development, and help establish finance processes in a dynamic, evolving environment.

About the Role

Reporting to a senior member of the finance team, the Project Accountant will support the financial management of a major development project. This position focuses on project accounting rather than traditional corporate accounting and offers broad exposure to project costing, financial reporting, procurement support, and process development. As the project grows, the scope of the role will continue to evolve, providing excellent opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor project costs, budgets, and expenditures to support effective financial management
  • Prepare project financial reports, forecasts, and analysis for finance and operational leadership
  • Track commitments, cost allocations, and project spending throughout the project lifecycle
  • Support procurement-related accounting activities, including invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, and cost tracking
  • Partner with project managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and support decision-making
  • Assist with month-end close activities, reconciliations, and financial reporting related to the project
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, and financial processes as the project develops
  • Help establish scalable finance procedures and best practices within a growing project environment
  • Support special projects and other finance initiatives as business needs evolve
  • Travel to the project site in Quebec as required to collaborate with operational stakeholders

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in project accounting or project finance
  • Experience within the mining, construction, engineering, infrastructure, or other project-based industries
  • Strong understanding of project costing, budgeting, cost tracking, and financial reporting
  • Bilingual communication skills in both French and English
  • Experience using ERP systems and strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to a changing project environment
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with both finance and operational teams
  • CPA designation is considered an asset but is not required
  • Ability to travel to project sites within Quebec as needed

Why Join

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing organization during an exciting stage of project development. You'll play a key role in building financial processes, working alongside operational teams, and contributing directly to the success of a major capital project. If you're looking for a broad, hands-on accounting role with meaningful impact, strong autonomy, and long-term growth potential, this position offers an excellent next step in your career.

 

Comptable de projet

Une organisation axée sur les projets dans le secteur des ressources naturelles et des infrastructures est à la recherche d'un Comptable de projet pour se joindre à son équipe des finances afin de soutenir un important projet de développement au Québec. Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, de contribuer à la réussite financière d'un projet d'envergure et de participer à la mise en place des processus financiers dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

À propos du poste

Relevant d'un membre senior de l'équipe des finances, le Comptable de projet jouera un rôle clé dans la gestion financière d'un important projet de développement. Ce poste est principalement axé sur la comptabilité de projet plutôt que sur la comptabilité corporative traditionnelle. Vous serez impliqué dans le suivi des coûts de projet, la production de rapports financiers, le soutien aux activités d'approvisionnement ainsi que l'amélioration des processus financiers. À mesure que le projet évoluera, les responsabilités associées au poste se développeront également, offrant d'excellentes possibilités de croissance professionnelle.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Assurer le suivi des coûts, des budgets et des dépenses du projet afin de soutenir une gestion financière efficace.
  • Préparer les rapports financiers, les prévisions et les analyses destinés aux équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Effectuer le suivi des engagements financiers, des répartitions de coûts et des dépenses tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.
  • Soutenir les activités comptables liées aux approvisionnements, notamment le traitement des factures, les rapprochements avec les fournisseurs et le suivi des coûts.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projet et les équipes opérationnelles afin de fournir des analyses financières favorisant une prise de décision éclairée.
  • Participer aux activités de clôture de fin de mois, aux rapprochements de comptes et à la production des rapports financiers liés au projet.
  • Identifier des occasions d'améliorer les processus financiers, les contrôles internes et les outils de production de rapports à mesure que le projet progresse.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la documentation de procédures financières évolutives ainsi que des meilleures pratiques.
  • Participer à des projets spéciaux et à d'autres initiatives financières selon les besoins de l'organisation.
  • Se déplacer au site du projet au Québec, au besoin, afin de collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Minimum de trois (3) années d'expérience en comptabilité de projet ou en finance de projet.
  • Expérience acquise dans les secteurs minier, de la construction, de l'ingénierie, des infrastructures ou dans tout autre environnement axé sur les projets.
  • Excellente compréhension du suivi des coûts de projet, de la budgétisation, de l'analyse des coûts et de la production de rapports financiers.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en français et en anglais.
  • Expérience avec un système ERP ainsi qu'une très bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à gérer plusieurs priorités et à évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en collaboration avec les équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Le titre de CPA constitue un atout, mais n'est pas une exigence.
  • Disponibilité pour se déplacer sur le site du projet au Québec lorsque requis.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de vous joindre à une organisation à une étape clé du développement d'un projet majeur. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la mise en place des processus financiers, collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles et contribuerez directement au succès d'un important projet d'investissement. Si vous recherchez un poste diversifié, concret et offrant une grande autonomie, où vous pourrez avoir un impact réel tout en poursuivant votre développement professionnel, cette opportunité pourrait représenter la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

job.title: Investment Associate, Private Equity
job.description:
A private investment organization is seeking an entrepreneurial Investment Associate to join its lean investment team. This is a high-autonomy opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond analyzing transactions and take ownership of the investment process from initial sourcing through to execution.

The successful candidate will help identify and evaluate businesses that could become long-term investments, working closely with senior investment leadership and external advisors along the way.

About the Role

This is a full-cycle investment position rather than a traditional finance or reporting role. You will be responsible for building a pipeline of potential acquisition opportunities, developing relationships with business owners and intermediaries, assessing investment opportunities, and supporting transactions through due diligence and closing.

The role is particularly well suited to someone who is commercially minded, highly resourceful, and energized by creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute strategies for identifying attractive acquisition opportunities
  • Research industries and build targeted lists of potential investment candidates
  • Proactively source opportunities through direct outreach and relationship development
  • Build relationships with business owners, advisors, intermediaries, and other relevant contacts
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of potential investments and track progress through the evaluation process
  • Review financial statements and assess the underlying performance and quality of potential investments
  • Build financial models and conduct valuation and investment analysis
  • Lead or coordinate due diligence activities across financial, operational, and commercial areas
  • Evaluate opportunities and present recommendations to senior investment leadership
  • Support negotiations and transaction execution from initial interest through completion
  • Provide regular updates on sourcing activity, pipeline development, and investment opportunities
  • Adapt between sourcing, analysis, and execution depending on the needs of the investment pipeline

What You Bring

  • Approximately 4–7 years of relevant experience in investment, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or a related field
  • CPA designation is strongly preferred, particularly for candidates with a background in transaction services, financial due diligence, or public accounting
  • Strong financial analysis, modelling, and valuation capabilities
  • Experience evaluating businesses or investment opportunities from a financial and commercial perspective
  • Transaction or deal experience is a significant asset
  • Excellent research and analytical skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Commercial judgment and genuine curiosity about how businesses operate
  • Comfort working with senior stakeholders, business owners, and external advisors

What Will Make You Successful

This role requires more than technical investment skills. You should be someone who:

  • Takes initiative and can operate effectively with limited direction
  • Is comfortable building processes and approaches from the ground up
  • Has the confidence and persistence to initiate conversations and generate opportunities
  • Enjoys picking up the phone, conducting outreach, and developing relationships
  • Can move comfortably between detailed analysis and broader commercial thinking
  • Is intellectually curious, adaptable, and open to learning
  • Can take ownership of a broad mandate and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome

A key part of the screening process will be understanding whether you have personally generated investment or acquisition opportunities, rather than only evaluating opportunities that were sourced by others.

Why Join

This is a rare opportunity to gain end-to-end exposure to the investment process within a lean, entrepreneurial environment. Rather than owning one narrow part of a transaction, you'll have the opportunity to participate across sourcing, analysis, diligence, relationship management, and execution.

You'll work closely with experienced investment leadership and have meaningful ownership over the search for the organization's next long-term investment. For the right individual, the role offers substantial autonomy, accelerated learning, and the opportunity to build a career around investing rather than simply advising on transactions.

job.title: Director of Finance, FP&A
job.description:
A growing, project-driven organization is seeking a Director of Finance, FP&A to play a key role in financial planning, analysis, treasury, and business decision support. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working closely with senior leadership while also getting into the details of the numbers and operations.

About the Role

This position will lead core FP&A activities while supporting cash management, financing, and project-level financial analysis. The successful candidate will bring a commercial mindset, strong financial modelling capabilities, and the ability to turn complex financial information into practical recommendations.The role will also have an opportunity to strengthen and evolve the organization's financial planning and reporting processes as the business continues to grow.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the annual budgeting process and coordinate ongoing financial planning activities
  • Own regular forecasting and reforecasting, ensuring leadership has a clear view of expected financial performance
  • Develop financial models and forward-looking analysis to support business planning and decision-making
  • Analyze budget-to-actual results, identify meaningful variances, and communicate key drivers to leadership
  • Monitor financial trends, risks, opportunities, and performance indicators
  • Prepare management reporting, analysis, and presentations for senior leadership and ownership
  • Support cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and day-to-day treasury activities
  • Assist with banking relationships, financing requirements, and ongoing lender reporting
  • Prepare financial analysis and supporting information for debt financing and banking partners
  • Evaluate project-level financial performance, including costs, profitability, cash requirements, and projected returns
  • Support project accounting and finance activities as required
  • Provide financial insights to inform operational, investment, and strategic decisions
  • Identify opportunities to improve FP&A, reporting, forecasting, and financial planning processes

What You Bring

  • Senior Manager or Director-level experience in finance, FP&A, corporate finance, or a related discipline
  • Significant experience leading budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes
  • Strong financial modelling and analytical capabilities
  • Experience with treasury, cash flow forecasting, and liquidity management
  • Exposure to bank financing, debt facilities, and lender relationships
  • Strong understanding of financial performance analysis and variance reporting
  • Experience supporting project-based, capital-intensive, or operationally complex businesses is an asset
  • Ability to confidently present financial information and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Strong commercial and operational judgment, with an ability to connect financial results to business performance
  • Comfortable operating in a hands-on environment rather than focusing exclusively on high-level strategy
  • CPA designation is an asset, although strong FP&A and corporate finance experience will be highly valued
  • Adaptable and comfortable working within an evolving organizational structure

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible finance leadership role within a growing organization where your analysis can directly influence business decisions. You'll have meaningful exposure to senior leadership, ownership, financing activities, and project performance while helping build more effective financial planning and reporting practices.

job.title: Credit & Collections Specialist
job.description:
A respected organization is seeking a Credit & Collections Specialist to join its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced collections professional who enjoys building customer relationships, solving payment issues, and contributing to the overall financial health of the business. Because every overdue invoice has a story your job is helping ensure it has an ending.

About the Role

Reporting to the finance leadership team, this role is responsible for managing customer accounts, supporting collection activities, and maintaining accurate financial records. You'll work independently while collaborating closely with internal teams to resolve billing concerns and improve cash flow.

What You'll Do

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on outstanding receivables
  • Contact customers by phone and email to resolve overdue balances professionally and efficiently
  • Investigate account discrepancies, payment issues, deductions, and invoice disputes
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, payment arrangements, and collection activities
  • Process customer transactions and update account information within the organization's accounting system
  • Apply payments and assist with account reconciliations to ensure accurate account balances
  • Review aging reports to prioritize collection efforts and identify high-risk accounts
  • Escalate complex or significantly overdue accounts when appropriate
  • Partner with internal departments to resolve billing questions and improve the customer payment experience
  • Provide additional administrative and operational support to the finance team as needed

What You Bring

  • Previous experience in credit, collections, accounts receivable, or a related accounting function
  • Proven experience managing collections and communicating directly with customers regarding outstanding balances
  • Experience working with ERP or accounting systems
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Professional, tactful, and customer-focused approach when handling sensitive financial matters
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment

Why Join

This is an opportunity to become part of a collaborative finance team where your contributions directly support the organization's success. The company values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, offering a stable environment with opportunities to develop your skills and make a meaningful impact. It's the kind of role where diplomacy, persistence, and a well-timed follow-up email can be just as valuable as knowing the numbers.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
An organization in the natural resources and investment sector is looking for a hands-on Senior Accountant or Accounting Consultant to support its lean finance team. This part-time opportunity is well suited to an experienced accounting professional who enjoys working independently, taking ownership, and helping build stronger financial processes.

The initial commitment is approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential for the workload to fluctuate based on business needs. The role offers significant flexibility and can be structured around a consulting or contract arrangement.

About the Role

Working closely with senior finance leadership, you will play an important role in maintaining accounting accuracy, supporting financial reporting, and strengthening processes and controls.

This is a hands-on position rather than a purely transactional role. You'll review work prepared by external providers, investigate issues, support reporting requirements, and work directly with external auditors. The environment is lean, so the ability to operate with limited direction and respond quickly when priorities shift is important.

What You'll Do

  • Review accounting work completed by external service providers and ensure transactions are accurate and properly supported

  • Review accounts payable, general ledger activity, journal entries, and account reconciliations

  • Support month-end close activities and preparation of financial statements

  • Assist with periodic financial reporting and related schedules

  • Work directly with external auditors by coordinating requests, preparing supporting documentation, and addressing follow-up questions

  • Support cash management, payment requirements, and other time-sensitive finance matters

  • Review purchasing and invoice processes to ensure appropriate controls are followed

  • Support accounting requirements across multiple entities

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, documentation, and internal controls

  • Assist with financial analysis and planning activities as the role develops

What You Bring

  • Approximately 6+ years of progressive accounting experience

  • Strong full-cycle accounting experience with the ability to work independently

  • Experience reviewing accounting work and identifying discrepancies or control issues

  • Strong understanding of month-end close, reconciliations, journal entries, and financial statements

  • Experience working with external auditors and supporting audit processes

  • Excellent attention to detail and a highly organized, process-oriented approach

  • Ability to take ownership of priorities and respond effectively to urgent requests

  • Comfortable working in a lean environment where responsibilities can span multiple areas

  • Experience with accounting or ERP systems; familiarity with cloud-based accounting platforms is an asset

  • Public-company, multi-entity, capital markets, or regulated reporting experience is considered an asset

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility within a lean and entrepreneurial finance environment. You'll work directly with senior leadership, gain exposure to complex reporting and audit activities, and have the opportunity to improve processes rather than simply maintain them.

The flexible part-time structure makes this particularly well suited to an experienced accounting professional seeking consulting, fractional, or contract work. As the organization evolves, there may also be opportunities for the scope and level of responsibility to expand.

job.title: FP&A Manager
job.description:
A leading organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses is looking for an experienced FP&A Manager to join its finance team. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Finance, this role will support a major area of the organization through financial planning, forecasting, reporting, performance analysis, and process improvement.

This is a hands-on management role that combines detailed financial analysis with team leadership and business partnership. The FP&A Manager will work closely with finance, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure financial information is accurate, timely, and meaningful, while providing insights that support planning and decision-making.

What You'll Do

  • Lead FP&A consolidation activities across multiple business areas, including forecasts, business plans, and quarterly results, ensuring information is complete, accurate, and appropriately reviewed.
  • Lead recurring budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, working closely with finance and operational stakeholders to meet established timelines.
  • Review forecasts, actual results, and business plans, analyzing key drivers, trends, and variances and identifying areas that require further investigation.
  • Coordinate quarterly planning, forecasting, and reporting deliverables, ensuring information is reviewed and submitted accurately and on time.
  • Prepare and review profitability and performance analysis, providing insight into business drivers, trends, and financial results.
  • Prepare management reports, financial analysis, and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Serve as a key finance partner to business and operating teams, supporting financial planning, reporting, and issue resolution.
  • Oversee the use and enhancement of financial planning, consolidation, and reporting systems to improve reporting, forecasting, and analysis capabilities.
  • Lead and develop a small team of finance professionals while remaining hands-on with detailed analysis, review, and key FP&A deliverables.
  • Build strong relationships across finance, operations, and business teams to support effective communication, collaboration, and timely decision-making.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of forecasting, reporting, and analysis processes.
  • Support broader finance initiatives and strategic projects as required.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.
  • CPA designation.
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial reporting, or a related finance function.
  • 1–2 years of experience managing, supervising, or mentoring finance professionals.
  • Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, consolidation, variance analysis, and business performance reporting.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Experience with financial planning, consolidation, and reporting systems; experience with OneStream is an asset.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex financial information and identify key business drivers.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to translate financial analysis into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to work with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deliverables, priorities, and deadlines.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach, with a strong interest in improving processes and how finance teams operate.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible FP&A leadership role with broad exposure across the organization. You'll work closely with senior finance leaders and business stakeholders, have direct responsibility for important planning and reporting processes, and lead a small team while remaining hands-on with the analysis.

The role offers the opportunity to strengthen both your technical FP&A expertise and leadership experience while contributing directly to financial planning, performance management, and business decision-making.

job.title: Director, Supply Chain
job.description:
Our client, a growing organization in the mining sector, is looking for an experienced Director, Supply Chain to lead its supply chain function across corporate and operational environments.
This is a key leadership role responsible for procurement, contracts, logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations. Based in Toronto, the Director will lead a team located primarily in Saskatoon and partner closely with the operations group and senior leadership.
 
About the Role
The role is becoming available due to a planned retirement and offers the opportunity to take over an established function with systems and processes already in place, while identifying opportunities to improve and scale the function as the organization continues to grow.
 
What You’ll Do
  • Lead the overall supply chain function, including procurement, contracts, logistics, warehousing, and vendor management.
  • Manage and develop a team of procurement and warehouse professionals based in Saskatoon.
  • Partner closely with operations to support day-to-day requirements and longer-term business priorities.
  • Oversee significant corporate and operational contracts, including negotiations, commercial terms, supplier performance, and risk management.
  • Support supply chain requirements related to a major project currently in the construction phase.
  • Manage procurement and logistics priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Oversee warehousing, inventory management, and related supply chain processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement strategy, systems, controls, reporting, cost management, and vendor relationships.
  • Maintain and enhance existing supply chain processes rather than rebuilding the function from scratch.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers, contractors, and operational leadership.
  • Provide coaching, leadership, and direction to the supply chain team.
What We’re Looking For
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, procurement, contracts, logistics, or a related area.
  • Proven experience leading a supply chain or procurement function.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including managing teams across multiple locations.
  • Significant experience negotiating and managing large or complex contracts.
  • Strong understanding of procurement, logistics, warehousing, inventory, and vendor management.
  • Experience working closely with operations in a complex or fast-moving environment.
  • Mining industry experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience from related sectors such as construction, heavy industrial, energy, natural resources, manufacturing, or infrastructure may also be considered.
  • Experience supporting large capital projects or construction environments is an asset.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and navigate operational demands.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities

job.title: Senior Manager, Regulatory Finance
job.description:
We're recruiting a Senior Manager, Regulatory Finance for a leadership opportunity with a major infrastructure organization. This role focuses on the financial and accounting side of regulatory activities, supporting the preparation, analysis, and defence of financial information used in regulatory filings.

This is an excellent fit for a senior finance professional with utility experience who understands how financial information supports regulatory requirements and enjoys working across finance, operations, and leadership teams.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead the preparation and analysis of financial information supporting regulatory filings.
  • Provide financial and accounting expertise throughout the regulatory reporting process.
  • Review financial data, schedules, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Support the development of financial information and analysis used to substantiate regulatory submissions.
  • Assist with responding to questions, information requests, and challenges related to regulatory filings.
  • Work closely with finance, accounting, operational, and regulatory stakeholders to coordinate filing requirements.
  • Analyze financial results and develop supporting schedules, reports, and presentations.
  • Ensure financial information is consistent with applicable accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Support regulatory reviews, hearings, audits, and other related activities as required.
  • Provide financial analysis and recommendations to senior leadership on regulatory matters.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen the efficiency, accuracy, and quality of regulatory reporting.
 

What You'll Bring

  • CPA designation or another relevant professional accounting designation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Significant progressive experience in finance, accounting, financial reporting, or regulatory finance.
  • Experience within the utility sector is strongly preferred.
  • Water utility experience is considered a significant asset.
  • Practical exposure to regulatory finance, regulatory accounting, or financial reporting for regulatory purposes.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, financial analysis, and reporting processes.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively with tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain financial information to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a complex, highly regulated environment.
 

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership role where your expertise will directly contribute to important regulatory and financial decisions. You'll work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams while developing deeper exposure to regulatory strategy, financial reporting, and business performance.

For an experienced utility finance professional looking to move further into regulatory finance, this role offers the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful work while contributing to the organization's broader financial objectives.

job.title: Senior Manager, Project Finance/Accounting
job.description:
We're recruiting a Senior Manager, Finance & Accounting for a leadership opportunity with a major infrastructure organization in Austin, Texas. This role will lead the finance and accounting function supporting the organization's Texas operations and multiple infrastructure-related business activities.

The organization develops and operates infrastructure for its customers, including large-scale water and treatment infrastructure. The Senior Manager will have broad responsibility across accounting, customer billing, collections, capital accounting, financial reporting, and financial operations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the finance and accounting function supporting multiple infrastructure projects and business operations.
  • Oversee project accounting, including project costs, financial activity, and reporting.
  • Lead customer billing and collections activities.
  • Manage accounting for capital expenditures and infrastructure investments.
  • Lead month-end and year-end close activities and ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and analyze financial statements, project results, and supporting schedules.
  • Monitor project financial performance and identify variances, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner closely with project, operations, finance, and leadership teams to support business decisions.
  • Ensure accounting processes and financial information are accurate, timely, and compliant with applicable accounting standards and internal policies.
  • Oversee accounting activities across multiple projects and business areas.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop accounting/finance team members.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.

What You'll Bring

  • CPA designation or another relevant professional accounting designation preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Significant progressive experience in project accounting, construction accounting, infrastructure, EPC, or another project-based environment.
  • Strong experience with project accounting, customer billing, collections, capital accounting, and financial reporting.
  • Experience overseeing accounting or finance activities across multiple projects, entities, or business operations.
  • Previous people leadership or team management experience.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, project financials, and reporting processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project, operational, finance, and senior leadership teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance and accounting leadership role supporting complex infrastructure projects across Texas. You'll have broad visibility across the business and the opportunity to influence project financial performance, accounting processes, reporting, and operational decision-making. You'll work closely with project teams, operations, finance, and senior leadership while overseeing accounting across multiple projects and business activities.

job.title: Senior Manager, FP&A & Reporting
job.description:
We're recruiting a Senior Manager, FP&A & Financial Reporting for a leadership opportunity with a major infrastructure organization. This role combines financial planning, performance analysis, and reporting, making it an excellent fit for a finance leader with strong experience in complex, regulated environments.

Working closely with senior leadership, you'll provide financial insight that supports operational performance, strategic planning, and informed decision-making. The position also offers the opportunity to lead and develop a finance team while contributing to broader business initiatives.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and performance analysis.
  • Oversee the preparation and delivery of accurate financial reports for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Analyze financial results, identify trends and variances, and provide recommendations to support business performance.
  • Develop financial models and reporting tools to support strategic planning and operational decision-making.
  • Partner with operational and functional leaders to provide financial guidance and meaningful business insights.
  • Support long-term financial planning and evaluate financial performance against established objectives.
  • Ensure financial reporting is accurate, timely, and aligned with applicable accounting and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead and support process improvements that strengthen financial reporting, planning, and analysis.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop finance professionals while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and other finance projects as required.
 

What You'll Bring

  • CPA designation or another relevant professional accounting designation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Significant progressive experience in FP&A, financial reporting, and business partnering, ideally at the Senior Manager level.
  • Strong experience within the utility or another regulated industry.
  • Experience in the water utility sector is considered a strong asset.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and financial reporting.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to coach, mentor, and develop finance professionals.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a complex, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and financial reporting systems.
 

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position where your analysis and recommendations will directly influence business planning and performance. You'll work closely with leadership, lead a talented finance team, and contribute to initiatives that shape the organization's financial direction. For someone with strong utility experience who enjoys combining FP&A, reporting, and people leadership, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

  • Provide financial guidance and business partnership to operational and functional leaders.

job.title: Manager of Finance
job.description:

This is an opportunity for an experienced accounting professional to take ownership of core financial processes, support business leaders with meaningful analysis, and help strengthen the organization's accounting operations.

 

About the Role

Reporting to a senior finance leader, the Manager, Finance will oversee a range of accounting and reporting activities while helping drive improvements across the finance function. You will act as a key financial resource to the broader business, ensuring accounting processes are accurate, well controlled, and aligned with applicable standards and internal policies.   • 4+ years of progressive accounting or audit experience.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and experience with financial reporting and period-end close.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial information and communicate meaningful insights to business leaders.
  • Experience overseeing or improving accounting processes and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of general ledger activities, reconciliations, accounts payable, and financial reporting.
  • Experience with accounting or ERP systems and a strong command of common financial reporting and productivity tools.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

This is an opportunity to step into a visible finance leadership role within a collaborative organization where accounting is viewed as an important business partner.You will have the opportunity to influence how finance operates, improve processes and controls, support senior leadership with financial insight, and contribute to projects that have a broader organizational impact.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:

job.title: Senior Financial Accountant
job.description:
A private investment organization is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Accountant to take ownership of day-to-day accounting and financial reporting across multiple companies and entities. This is a hands-on opportunity for a seasoned accounting professional who values stability, flexibility, and the ability to independently manage their responsibilities in a close-knit environment.

About the Role

The Senior Financial Accountant will oversee the full accounting cycle across the family office and its entities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, reconciliations, month-end close, financial statement preparation, and reporting. Working closely with senior leadership and external advisors, you will ensure financial information is accurate, organized, and delivered on time while maintaining the integrity of the accounting records across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

  • Manage full-cycle accounting and bookkeeping across multiple companies and entities.
  • Handle day-to-day accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice processing, payments, collections, and reconciliations.
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts and supporting schedules.
  • Complete month-end and year-end close activities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and adjustments.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements, reporting packages, and supporting schedules for senior leadership.
  • Prepare organized audit packages and supporting documentation for external auditors and professional advisors.
  • Complete bank reconciliations and monitor cash activity across multiple entities.
  • Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations as required.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and well-organized accounting records.
  • Coordinate accounting information and reporting requirements across multiple companies.
  • Support external audit, tax, and other professional advisory requirements.
  • Investigate discrepancies and outstanding items and follow through to resolution.
  • Provide senior leadership with accurate and timely financial information as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality when working with sensitive financial and investment information.

What You Bring

  • Extensive, hands-on accounting experience, ideally with responsibility for multiple companies or entities.
  • Strong understanding of the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, general ledger, reconciliations, and period-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and monthly reporting packages.
  • Experience preparing supporting documentation and audit packages for external auditors and professional advisors.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistently high standard of accuracy.
  • Highly dependable, organized, and diligent, with strong follow-through.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across several entities.
  • Strong Excel and accounting software experience.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to identify and resolve accounting issues independently.
  • Strong communication skills and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Experience in real estate, investment management, property management, real estate development, family office, or other multi-entity environments is an asset.
  • CPA or other professional accounting designation is ideal.
  • Comfortable in a stable, long-term individual-contributor role with a focus on ownership, consistency, and quality of work.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join an established private investment organization with a close-knit team and a stable, collaborative work environment. The role offers meaningful ownership of the accounting function, direct interaction with senior leadership, and flexibility in how working hours are structured while maintaining an on-site environment. With a sustainable workload and no regular evening or weekend requirements, this opportunity is well suited to an experienced accounting professional looking to continue using their expertise in a stable, flexible, and long-term role.

An established investment and asset management organization is seeking a Manager, Finance to join its team. This role offers broad exposure across finance, operations, reporting, and strategic initiatives within a complex investment environment. It is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional looking to work closely with senior leadership while contributing to high-impact business decisions and process improvements.
 
About the Role
Reporting to senior finance leadership, this position will play a key role in overseeing financial operations, reporting, forecasting, and stakeholder communications across a portfolio of investment entities. The successful candidate will combine strong technical accounting and finance expertise with leadership capabilities and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
 
What You'll Do
  • Oversee fund and investment operations, including financial reporting, stakeholder communications, and coordination with external service providers
  • Support treasury activities, liquidity management, and capital-related transactions
  • Prepare, analyze, and present financial and operational performance reports for leadership and key stakeholders
  • Lead initiatives to enhance reporting processes, data management, and operational efficiency
  • Develop expertise in areas such as fund administration, valuations, performance measurement, and investor reporting
  • Support annual valuation processes, including financial model reviews, assumption analysis, and executive-level presentations
  • Coordinate and manage annual audit activities, working closely with external auditors and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure financial records, reporting processes, and governance practices comply with applicable accounting standards and internal policies
  • Prepare financial analyses and business insights to support strategic planning, forecasting, and decision-making
  • Assist with fundraising activities and the preparation of materials for prospective investors
  • Mentor, develop, and provide guidance to junior finance team members
  • Contribute to special projects, process improvements, and ad hoc analyses as required

What You Bring

  • University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline
  • Professional accounting designation (CPA or equivalent)
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in accounting, audit, financial reporting, or investment finance
  • Strong financial systems knowledge and advanced Excel capabilities
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and financial modeling skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines
  • Experience leading projects and mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across various functions
  • Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on process optimization and operational efficiency

 

Why Join
This is an opportunity to join a collaborative and high-performing team where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of finance, operational, and strategic initiatives. The role offers meaningful interaction with senior leadership, opportunities to influence business decisions, and a clear path for professional growth within a dynamic investment environment.

job.title: Senior General Accountant
job.description:
A reputable organization is seeking a Senior General Accountant to join its finance team. This opportunity is ideal for a CPA-designated professional or CPA candidate nearing completion who is looking to expand their experience within a complex, multi-entity environment.

About the Role

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, the Senior General Accountant will play a key role in financial reporting, month-end close activities, account reconciliations, compliance filings, and audit support. The position offers exposure to both operational and financial accounting while providing opportunities to contribute to process improvements and cross-functional initiatives.

 

What You'll Do

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Prepare and review month-end, quarter-end, and year-end journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Support the preparation of accurate and timely financial statements and management reporting packages
  • Maintain general ledger accounts and ensure the integrity of financial records
  • Assist with financial analysis and reporting to support business decision-making
  • Participate in the preparation of trial balances and supporting schedules

Compliance, Audit & Regulatory Reporting

  • Support internal and external audit processes by preparing documentation and responding to inquiries
  • Assist with tax, regulatory, and other compliance-related filings
  • Ensure accounting practices and financial reporting activities comply with applicable standards and internal policies
  • Support the preparation of documentation required for year-end reporting activities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with departments across the organization to ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial information
  • Provide accounting guidance and support to internal stakeholders
  • Assist with special projects and business initiatives as required
  • Contribute to maintaining strong internal controls and financial processes

Process Improvement & Analysis

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, reporting efficiencies, and internal workflows
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives that support operational excellence
  • Analyze financial information and investigate variances to support accurate reporting
  • Contribute to ongoing enhancements in financial systems and reporting practices

What You Bring

  • Mandarin language proficiency is required
  • Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
  • CPA designation or active pursuit of a professional accounting designation with completion expected in the near term
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience gained through public practice, industry, or a combination of both
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting, account reconciliations, and month-end close processes
  • Knowledge of Canadian accounting standards and financial reporting principles
  • Experience working within a multi-entity or complex business environment is considered an asset
  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial analysis skills
  • Experience working with enterprise accounting and reporting systems
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines

 

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative and fast-paced organization where finance professionals are encouraged to take ownership of their work, contribute new ideas, and support continuous improvement. You'll gain exposure to a diverse range of accounting responsibilities, work alongside experienced finance leaders, and participate in initiatives that have a meaningful impact on the business. The organization offers competitive compensation, performance-based incentives, comprehensive benefits, retirement savings support, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for long-term professional growth within a dynamic and team-oriented environment.

The organization offers a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where high performers can make a measurable impact, develop cross-functional expertise, and grow into increasingly senior leadership responsibilities as the business continues to expand.

job.title: Controller
job.description:
A growing construction business is seeking a Controller to build and lead the company’s finance function. This is a high-impact opportunity for a hands-on CPA who wants to move beyond traditional reporting and play a strategic role in shaping the financial direction of a scaling organization.

About the Role
Reporting directly to senior leadership, this position will oversee the company’s full finance function while building the processes, reporting structure, and controls needed to support continued growth. The successful candidate will act as a strategic business partner to leadership and help drive stronger financial decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do
  • Take ownership of all day-to-day financial operations and transition the business to a more structured internal finance function
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
  • Develop and maintain budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow models to support business planning
  • Provide leadership with financial analysis and strategic insights to support operational and investment decisions
  • Establish internal controls, financial processes, and reporting standards appropriate for a growing business
  • Partner with operational leaders to evaluate profitability, margins, and overall business performance
  • Monitor working capital, cash flow, and liquidity to ensure the business is well-positioned for growth
  • Improve invoicing, collections, and payment processes to enhance financial efficiency
  • Build dashboards and reporting tools to provide timely visibility into key business metrics
  • Support implementation of systems, processes, and tools as the finance function evolves
  • Assist in building and mentoring a finance team over time as the organization grows

What You Bring
  • CPA designation required
  • Progressive experience in accounting/finance, including leadership responsibility within a growing organization
  • Construction industry experience is preferred. Experience in Construction adjacent or project based industries will also be considered.
  • Strong financial reporting, forecasting, and business partnering capabilities
  • Experience building or improving finance processes, controls, and reporting frameworks
  • Ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights
  • Hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Why Join
This is a rare opportunity to step into the first dedicated finance leadership role within a growing organization and help build the finance function from the ground up. You’ll have direct exposure to senior leadership, significant ownership over financial strategy, and the chance to make a measurable impact on the business’s long-term success.

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Our client, a leading mid-sized public accounting practice in Canada, is renowned for its commitment to “Client Service” excellence and dependability. The firm specializes in assurance, accounting, tax, consulting, corporate finance, and M&A.
 
About the Role
Their Toronto office is seeking highly motivated Senior Staff Accountants to join the Assurance Group. This is a progressive opportunity for individuals looking to advance their careers in public accounting.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct audits of financial statements in accordance with Canadian auditing standards and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and review working papers, financial statements, and related reports for accuracy and completeness.
  • Assist in the preparation of tax returns and provide tax planning support for clients.
  • Collaborate with team members to identify and implement process improvements for efficiency in audit and accounting procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with clients to understand their needs and provide exceptional service throughout the engagement.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior staff members, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Stay current with industry developments, changes in regulations, and best practices in accounting and auditing.
  • Assist in managing project timelines and deliverables to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations, contributing insights and recommendations based on analysis.
  • Support management in the development of client relationships and business opportunities.

  • Proficiency in computer applications, including Caseware, Taxprep, and Excel.
  • Strong file documentation skills.
  • A deadline-oriented mindset and effective time management abilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Professionalism in interactions with clients and colleagues.
  • A dedication to teamwork and leadership.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

Why Join
This is a great opportunity to grow your career in a firm that values mentorship, promotes from within, and supports work-life balance. You'll be part of a team that prides itself on professionalism, innovation, and client success. If you’re looking for a people-first environment where your contribution matters, this role is for you.

job.title: Fund Accounting Manager (Private Assets)
job.description:

This is a high-impact leadership role ideal for professionals who bring a deep understanding of fund accounting and a passion for team development, process improvement, and client service excellence.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Manage a high-performing team to ensure departmental goals are met
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the fund accounting team, ensuring accuracy and efficiency
  • Lead the calculation and review of Net Asset Values (NAVs), financial statements, trial balances, and partner/shareholder allocations
  • Review complex fund expenses including management fees, admin fees, carried interest, and more
  • Ensure the quality and accuracy of all accounting work and client deliverables, including investor statements

  • Mentor, train, and guide team members, conducting performance reviews and identifying development opportunities
  • Lead initiatives to improve operational efficiency and implement quality control measures
 
What You Bring
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field
  • CPA, CFA, or equivalent accounting designation preferred
  • 3–5 years of hands-on fund accounting experience with private equity or alternative investment funds
  • 4+ years of experience managing fund accounting teams
  • Solid understanding of US/Canadian GAAP and fund-level financial reporting
  • Experience preparing and reviewing general ledgers and financial statements
  • Strong leadership and people management skills
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities
  • Advanced Excel skills
 
Why This Role

This is a chance to step into a key leadership position with a global organization that values accuracy, innovation, and team development. You'll be central to delivering best-in-class fund accounting services to high-profile clients while leading a team committed to continuous improvement.
